children.game_version: Mirroring game where children maintain a 'hug' while moving in small, synchronized steps.

seniors.seated_version: Partners sit facing each other, focusing on upper body connection and arm placement.
seniors.standing_version: Maintain the close embrace while standing stationary, focusing on the lean without complex footwork.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo, minimal range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Close embrace, woman's left hand around man's neck or back.
movement_profile.posture: Apilado (lean), straight back for the woman, man leans slightly toward partner.

signature_moves.description: A leaning posture where the woman leans against the man's chest.
signature_moves.name: Apilado

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Large exhibitionist movements or showy dance figures.

basic_steps: Execute small steps in synchronization with partner
Perform subtle foot adornments before the beat
teaching.level_notes: Requires high level of connection and spatial awareness due to the close embrace.
